Direct trigger independently gates cooldown0 and canTarget, then caches target, starts local FX/sound request and cooldown8. This accepted trigger precedes actual action and is not possession success.

ATTACK delegates to current controller INTERACT and explicitly has no tick/packet behavior; it cannot supply a second mechanism. C2S writes enum and target int ID only. Server queued handler resolves current-world entity and strict distance<range+3, ignores useDirect return and requests owner sync even after rejection.

AbilityBase only server-decrements positive cooldown; changed setCooldown assigns, invokes sync then onCooldownEnd for0. ReadFromPacket uses same setter. Source call order does not prove eager CCA serialization, arrival or action/outcome ordering.

Player soulAbilities final instance is retained, but only current delegate ticks and serializes. Delegate replacement clears weak target lookup and syncs, not cached Vagrant fields or cooldown. Precompletion delegate switches can therefore conditionally pause/resume pending state. No reproduced stale action or durable save/respawn claim.

Normal callback clears cached action/target after action, without finally; a throwing callback could bypass clearing. No actual exception reproduced. FX weak anchor is cleared on ack or loss of incorporeality; fishEye counter decrement alone has no <=0 anchor timeout in the read method.

Controller sync follows regardless of missing target, range rejection or direct refusal. No attempt ID, UUID, dimension epoch, reason or outcome.

Server update decrements positive counter. setCooldown assigns changed value, invokes sync, then invokes onCooldownEnd if0. Source sync invocation precedes delayed action; this proves neither serialization timing nor delivery/arrival/client execution order.

Client apply reads setCooldown. Changed positive->zero calls Vagrant.onCooldownEnd -> onPossessionAck -> weak FX target.clear. Generic actual possession still rechecks readiness, callbacks and host.canBePossessedBy, so this is not a blanket admission bypass claim.

After normal completion cached target/interaction are null; no finally surrounds action.accept, so thrown action could skip clearing (no actual exception reproduced). FX anchor weak and client tick clears if no longer incorporeal. Animation counter decrements but has no <=0 anchor timeout in that method.

dedup_current_complete_migration_substan.preservation: PlayerManager mixin prepare在clone局部变量上触发(original,clone,returnFromEnd)，后存clone.world ThreadLocal，碰撞向上移有Y<256上限；另hook读取该world，RETURN事件用cir.getReturnValue新玩家。plugin原死则resetIdentity(clone)，再新组件prepare；Mutable.prepare只在!lossless&&!isVagrant时setVagrant并复制原维度/位置，original.isDead才加Attrition；随后仅StickyStatusEffect谓词通过的效果复制newInstance，而非全部effects。RemnantComponent.prepare用try/finally清splitting。 Master: 主责全文审128完整方法1233行3块+22字段/静态初始化。remnant type/id ethereal永久资格、真实选择写入、derived movement/免伤按语义重建、ALWAYS_COPY与respawn新对象钩子和split/merge载荷去重作为同一身份族1。CCA策略外部实现未重读，声明不当作实测；区别于Identity变形解锁集合与copyFrom实现，数据owner和消费机制独立。PlayerManager RETURN确实cir.getReturnValue，与Identity原形参风险有明确对照。split排除原生UUID/XP/EnderItems/abilities等再按ALWAYS_COPY去重只是一套宽黑名单，未列临时字段仍可复制，不可移植为本项目全NBT；merge先移库存冲突drop后整tag覆盖非事务。fakeplayer拒绝remnant、旧PlayerProfile兼容和DeathSuspender都支持0额外信用，后者读deathCause条件client却castServerWorld且不保存20tick倒计时是具体静态风险，不称可用永久修复。未知合法ID DefaultedRegistry与坏Identifier区别记录，无unknownpayload隔离。仅审所供完整方法而非其所在全部大文件；跨版本MC1.19.3与Quilt/CCA不直接移植。
dedup_current_complete_migration_substan.application_limit: PlayerSplitter先native writeNbt，再删除UUID、SpawnX/Y/Z/Forced/Angle/Dimension、EnderItems、abilities、playerGameType/previousPlayerGameType、seenCredits、XpP/Level/Total；CCA ALWAYS_COPY组件从分身NBT去掉，剩余template覆盖to.writeNbt再to.readNbt，因此是宽黑名单，未列临时键仍可带过，非安全白名单。performRespawn临时keepInventory=false/清spawn，finally恢复原对象spawn与gamerule，新clone恢复spawn并重绑定networkHandler；spawnEntity结果未检，非事务承诺。merge真实库存先逐槽移/冲突drop、再dropAll余项以免modded inventory void，后copy数据和加经验，第三方槽/Stack坏ID/unknownNBT无损未核。PlayerShell旧PlayerProfile读为displayprofile，writer仅modelparts+super；nativeFakeServerPlayerEntity displayprofile持久未展开，不独立credit。DeathSuspender只LOSSLESS_ONLY，NBT写lifeTransient/deathCause不写对话倒计时；reader deathCause条件是world.isClient却castServerWorld，server不恢复cause，未清旧cause；倒计时重载后能否再触发未知，非有效永久字段迁移建议。DamageSourceSerialization可丢未知name为GENERIC，source/attacker UUID读取无containsUuid guard，native缺失行为未核。 固定上游源码静态审阅，不直接移植跨版本API，不宣称原生运行验证。未执行上游操作或游戏；固定Requiem MC1.19.3源码不能替代Dynasty原生验收。
